text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 8 November 2012.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 8 November 2012 hingga 17 November 2012.

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 8 November 2012.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 8 November 2012 to 17 November 2012.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

[Paragraph 2]

Local bone-in mutton

Imported bone-in mutton

Imported boneless mutton (not including leg)

Imported bone-in mutton leg

Tomato

Dhal (Australia)
